CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION esim_private.recharge_can_accept()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT coalesce((SELECT a.recharge_enabled AND a.recharge_contract_verified AND a.wallet_boundary_verified
 AND p.discovery_enabled FROM esim_private.accounts a CROSS JOIN esim_private.recharge_policy p WHERE a.account_key='primary' AND p.singleton),false);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.snapshot_esim_catalogue_order()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NEW.operation_kind='fixed_recharge' THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('provider',c.provider,'bundle_name',c.bundle_name,
    'catalogue_details',c.catalogue_details,'countries',c.countries,
    'data_amount_mb',c.data_amount_mb,'duration_days',c.duration_days,
    'is_unlimited',c.is_unlimited,'retail_price_usd',NEW.retail_price_usd,
    'catalogue_observed_at',c.updated_at)
  INTO NEW.catalogue_snapshot FROM public.esim_offers_cache c
  WHERE c.provider=NEW.provider AND c.bundle_name=NEW.bundle_name;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION esim_private.topup_context(p user_esims)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT md5(jsonb_build_array(p.user_id,p.provider,p.supplier_account_id,p.supplier_profile_ref,p.iccid,
 p.profile_state,p.bundle_state,p.installation_state,p.confirmed_expires_at,p.activation_deadline_at,
 p.last_observation_at,p.usage_error_code,p.plan_details,
 (SELECT catalogue_revision FROM esim_private.recharge_policy WHERE singleton))::text);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION esim_private.topup_refusal(p user_esims)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$DECLARE reason text; BEGIN
 reason:=esim_private.topup_refusal_base(p); IF reason IS NOT NULL THEN RETURN reason; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.esim_orders WHERE recharge_profile_id=p.id AND status IN('pending','processing')) THEN RETURN 'UNRESOLVED_OPERATION'; END IF;
 RETURN NULL; END $function$
